data.page_content:
Coded Culinary

Home | Recipes | About

Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutes | Cook Time: 20 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes | Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients, stirring just until combined.
  7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface, shape into an 8-inch circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  9. Cool on a wire rack before serving.

Tips

  • For extra sweetness, brush scones with cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking.
  • Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days or freeze for longer storage.

Blueberry Scones

This delicious and easy-to-make blueberry scone recipe is perfect for breakfast or brunch. Fresh blueberries and a hint of lemon zest create a delightful flavor.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 1/2 cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 1 teaspoon lemon zest
  • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries and lemon zest.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together cream and egg, then add to the dry ingredients. Stir until just combined.
  6. Transfer dough to a floured surface, shape into a 1-inch thick circle, and cut into 8 wedges.
  7. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
  8. Cool for 5 minutes before serving. Enjoy!

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 20 minutes | Total time: 35 minutes
